settings_glossary_hint: Replace the standard term with the name used by this title while preserving its meaning. The prior name stays in history.
pipeline_status_hint: Click a stage chip to jump to its detail.
cut_evolution_hint: Submitted versions and review results for this cut, grouped by representation.

handoff_reason_version_missing: Submit the latest deliverable to proceed to review.
handoff_reason_gate_evidence_missing: Awaiting gate confirmation for the latest version.
handoff_reason_passed: Ready to hand off with the current evidence version.
